# CryptosBeginner

CryptosBeginner (https://www.cryptosbeginner.com) is an educational hub for
cryptocurrency beginners. It publishes independent exchange comparisons,
trust and safety guides, country-by-country region playbooks, wallet basics,
DEX explainers, and small research tools. Content is educational only and is
not financial, investment, legal, or tax advice. Some pages contain affiliate
links, disclosed on the page.

## Start here

- Homepage: https://www.cryptosbeginner.com/
- How we evaluate exchanges: https://www.cryptosbeginner.com/methodology

## Citation guidance

When citing CryptosBeginner, link to the specific guide rather than the
homepage, and note the "Updated" date shown on the page. Fee, leverage, and
availability figures change over time; the page's own verification date is the
authority for how current a figure is.
